searches.query: I do not have a membership. My ordinary US order was 80 dollars before a 10-dollar discount, before tax. Is standard shipping free?

chunks.text: Standard delivery prices  For ordinary parcels to the contiguous United States, standard ground delivery costs USD 6 when the qualifying merchandise subtotal is below USD 75. At USD 75 or more, standard delivery is free. The qualifying subtotal is calculated after discounts and before sales tax. Gift cards do not count toward it. A basket that was above the threshold before a discount may fall below it afterward.  An active store membership reduces the free standard-delivery threshold to USD 40. The membership must be active when the order is placed. Becoming a member later does not retroactively refund an earlier delivery charge. Membership is linked to the purchasing customer, not automatically to everyone at the same address.  Oversize products have a separate delivery charge and do not receive free delivery under either threshold. The oversize-delivery article explains the fee. Express service has its own price and restrictions; free standard delivery does not mean free express delivery.

Express service has its own price and restrictions; free standard delivery does not mean free express delivery. Any original outbound shipping charge remains separate from the item price when the customer later makes a change-of-mind return. The checkout presents the final delivery options before payment.

Store membership benefits  An active annual membership costs USD 24 and lasts 12 months from purchase. Members receive the lower standard-delivery threshold described in the shipping-price policy and can join the equipment-repair queue with priority handling. Priority handling changes the queue position; it does not make the repair free or guarantee a completion date.  Membership does not waive return-label charges, express-delivery charges, oversize-delivery charges, or repair prices. It does not extend the standard return window or the boot fit-trial window. A customer who has both a membership and an eligible product-specific benefit can use those benefits under their separate rules. Support should state which benefit applies rather than calling all shipping or returns free.  Benefits start when membership is activated. Orders placed before activation retain their original delivery charges. A membership is attached to one customer account and cannot be shared across unrelated accounts. The policy explains the benefits and annual duration; it does not reveal a particular customer's current membership status.

evidence.text: Standard delivery prices  For ordinary parcels to the contiguous United States, standard ground delivery costs USD 6 when the qualifying merchandise subtotal is below USD 75. At USD 75 or more, standard delivery is free. The qualifying subtotal is calculated after discounts and before sales tax. Gift cards do not count toward it. A basket that was above the threshold before a discount may fall below it afterward.  An active store membership reduces the free standard-delivery threshold to USD 40. The membership must be active when the order is placed. Becoming a member later does not retroactively refund an earlier delivery charge. Membership is linked to the purchasing customer, not automatically to everyone at the same address.  Oversize products have a separate delivery charge and do not receive free delivery under either threshold. The oversize-delivery article explains the fee. Express service has its own price and restrictions; free standard delivery does not mean free express delivery.

Express service has its own price and restrictions; free standard delivery does not mean free express delivery. Any original outbound shipping charge remains separate from the item price when the customer later makes a change-of-mind return. The checkout presents the final delivery options before payment.

Store membership benefits  An active annual membership costs USD 24 and lasts 12 months from purchase. Members receive the lower standard-delivery threshold described in the shipping-price policy and can join the equipment-repair queue with priority handling. Priority handling changes the queue position; it does not make the repair free or guarantee a completion date.  Membership does not waive return-label charges, express-delivery charges, oversize-delivery charges, or repair prices. It does not extend the standard return window or the boot fit-trial window. A customer who has both a membership and an eligible product-specific benefit can use those benefits under their separate rules. Support should state which benefit applies rather than calling all shipping or returns free.  Benefits start when membership is activated. Orders placed before activation retain their original delivery charges. A membership is attached to one customer account and cannot be shared across unrelated accounts. The policy explains the benefits and annual duration; it does not reveal a particular customer's current membership status.
